statements.__comment__: This account's roles drop their stale trust edges to principals no AWS account owns (outside the known accounts). Another tenant's principals and trust edges are not touched.
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:AWSRole)-[r:TRUSTS_AWS_PRINCIPAL]->(n:AWSPrincipal) WHERE NOT (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount) AND r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment__: Orphan sweep, independent of the tenant: an outside principal is shared by every role that trusts it, so it goes only once nothing links to it.
statements.query: MATCH (n:AWSPrincipal) WHERE NOT (n)--() WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
